  WALMART_LABELS,
  type WalmartModel,
} from '@/lib/data/walmart'

type Theme = 'dark' | 'light'
type Module = 'property' | 'diamonds' | 'walmart'

const formatNumber = (value: number, digits = 1) => value.toLocaleString('ru-RU', { maximumFractionDigits: digits, minimumFractionDigits: 0 })
const formatPercent = (value: number, digits = 1) => `${value >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${formatNumber(value * 100, digits)}%`
const formatMoneyK = (value: number) => `$${formatNumber(value * 100, 1)}k`
const formatUsd = (value: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(value)
const formatSales = (value: number) => `$${(value / 1_000_000).toLocaleString('en-US', { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 })}M`
const formatAxisDate = (value: string) => value ? `${value.slice(5, 7)}/${value.slice(2, 4)}` : ''
const sumValues = (values: number[]) => values.reduce((total, value) => total + value, 0)
const mean = (values: number[]) => values.length ? meanValue(values) : 0
const chartPalette = {
  cyan: '#22d3ee',
  indigo: '#818cf8',
  green: '#34d399',
  amber: '#fbbf24',
  rose: '#fb7185',
  purple: '#c4b5fd',
}

const initialDiamond: DiamondInputs = {
  carat: 1, cut: 'Ideal', color: 'G', clarity: 'VS1', depth: 61.5, table: 57, x: 6.5, y: 6.5, z: 3.9,
}

function MetricCard({ label, value, note, tone = 'cyan', icon }: { label: string; value: string; note: string; tone?: string; icon?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <article className={`metric-card tone-${tone}`}>
      <div className="metric-top"><span>{label}</span>{icon && <span className="metric-icon">{icon}</span>}</div>
      <div className="metric-value">{value}</div>
      <div className="metric-note">{note}</div>
    </article>
  )
}

function Card({ title, subtitle, children, className = '', right }: { title: string; subtitle?: string; children: ReactNode; className?: string; right?: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className={`panel ${className}`}>
      <div className="panel-heading">
        <div><h2>{title}</h2>{subtitle && <p>{subtitle}</p>}</div>
        {right && <div className="panel-heading-right">{right}</div>}
      </div>
      {children}
    </section>
  )
}

function SliderField({ label, value, min, max, step = 1, suffix = '', onChange }: { label: string; value: number; min: number; max: number; step?: number; suffix?: string; onChange: (value: number) => void }) {
  return (
    <div className="slider-field">
      <label><span>{label}</span><b>{formatNumber(value, step < 0.1 ? 2 : step < 1 ? 1 : 0)}{suffix}</b></label>
      <input type="range" min={min} max={max} step={step} value={value} onChange={(event) => onChange(Number(event.target.value))} />
      <div className="slider-limits"><span>{min}{suffix}</span><span>{max}{suffix}</span></div>
    </div>
  )
}

function RegressionConsole() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>(() => {
    try { return (localStorage.getItem('ml-hub-theme') as Theme | null) ?? 'dark' } catch { return 'dark' }
  })
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const tabParam = searchParams?.get('tab') ?? null
  const [activeModule, setActiveModule] = useState<Module>('property')

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tabParam === 'diamonds' || tabParam === 'walmart' || tabParam === 'property') {
      setActiveModule(tabParam)
    }
  }, [tabParam])
  const { data: housing, loading: housingLoading, error: housingError } = useHousingReport()
  const { data: walmart, loading: walmartLoading, error: walmartError } = useWalmartReport()
  const [selectedRegModel, setSelectedRegModel] = useState<string>('')
  const [selectedDiamondModel, setSelectedDiamondModel] = useState('XGBoost')
  const [diamond, setDiamond] = useState<DiamondInputs>(initialDiamond)
  const [propertyInputs, setPropertyInputs] = useState<Record<string, number>>({})
  const [selectedWalmartModel, setSelectedWalmartModel] = useState<string>('RandomForest')
  const [selectedWalmartStore, setSelectedWalmartStore] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [walmartHorizon, setWalmartHorizon] = useState<4 | 8 | 13>(13)
  const [walmartShowConfidence, setWalmartShowConfidence] = useState(true)
  const [walmartShowHolidays, setWalmartShowHolidays] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    // theme applied via data-theme on .mlr-root
    try { localStorage.setItem('ml-hub-theme', theme) } catch { /* storage may be unavailable */ }
  }, [theme])

  // когда report подгрузился — выбрать best-модель и заполнить слайдеры медианами
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!housing) return
    setSelectedRegModel(prev =>
      housing.models.find(m => m.name === prev) ? prev : housing.headline.best_model
    )
    setPropertyInputs((prev) => {
      // если уже есть значения пользователя — не перезатираем
      if (Object.keys(prev).length) return prev
      const defaults: Record<string, number> = {}
      for (const f of housing.meta.features) {
        const st = housing.data.feature_stats[f]
        defaults[f] = st ? st.median : 0
      }
      return defaults
    })
  }, [housing])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!walmart) return
    setSelectedWalmartModel(prev =>
      walmart.models.find(m => m.name === prev) ? prev : walmart.headline.best_model
    )
  }, [walmart])

  const currentWalmartModel: WalmartModel | null =
    walmart?.models.find((m) => m.name === selectedWalmartModel)
    ?? walmart?.models[walmart.models.length - 1]
    ?? null

  // 3 крупнейших + 2 мельчайших магазина: сразу видно контраст MAE vs MAPE.
  const walmartTopStores = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart) return []
    const sorted = [...walmart.per_store].sort((a, b) => b.avg_sales - a.avg_sales)
    return [...sorted.slice(0, 3), ...sorted.slice(-2)]
  }, [walmart])

  const walmartTopFeatures = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart) return []
    const list = walmart.feature_importance.RandomForest ?? []
    return [...list].sort((a, b) => b.value - a.value).slice(0, 3)
  }, [walmart])

  // Активный магазин: явный выбор, иначе первый из top-stores
  const walmartActiveStoreId: number | null =
    selectedWalmartStore ?? walmartTopStores[0]?.store ?? null

  // Полный недельный ряд выбранного магазина + наложение predictions на тестовые недели
  const walmartStoreSeries = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart || walmartActiveStoreId == null) return []
    const storeSeries = walmart.series_by_store[String(walmartActiveStoreId)]
    if (!storeSeries) return []

    // Индексы тестовых строк этого магазина (дата -> индекс в y_test / predictions)
    const testIdxForStore = new Map<string, number>()
    walmart.data.dates_test.forEach((date, i) => {
      if (walmart.data.stores_test[i] === walmartActiveStoreId) testIdxForStore.set(date, i)
    })

    const interval = currentWalmartModel ? 1.96 * currentWalmartModel.metrics.rmse : null

    return storeSeries.dates.map((date, i) => {
      const testIdx = testIdxForStore.get(date)
      const predicted =
        testIdx != null ? currentWalmartModel?.predictions[testIdx] ?? null : null
      const holiday = walmart.meta.holidays.find((h) => h.date === date) ?? null
      return {
        date,
        axisDate: formatAxisDate(date),
        actual: storeSeries.sales[i],
        predicted,
        low: predicted != null && interval != null ? predicted - interval : null,
        high: predicted != null && interval != null ? predicted + interval : null,
        holiday,
      }
    })
  }, [walmart, walmartActiveStoreId, currentWalmartModel])

  // Слайс последних N тестовых недель (горизонт)
  const walmartHorizonRows = useMemo(() => {
    const testRows = walmartStoreSeries.filter((r) => r.predicted != null)
    return testRows.slice(-walmartHorizon)
  }, [walmartStoreSeries, walmartHorizon])

  // WMAE / прогноз-сумма / YoY по горизонту
  const walmartHorizonStats = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart || walmartActiveStoreId == null || !walmartHorizonRows.length) {
      return { wmae: 0, forecastSum: 0, yoy: 0, lastYearSum: 0 }
    }
    const storeSeries = walmart.series_by_store[String(walmartActiveStoreId)]
    let wSum = 0, wAbs = 0, forecastSum = 0, lastYearSum = 0
    for (const row of walmartHorizonRows) {
      const y = row.actual
      const p = row.predicted ?? 0
      const isHoliday = !!row.holiday
      const w = isHoliday ? 5 : 1
      wSum += w
      wAbs += w * Math.abs(y - p)
      forecastSum += p
      // YoY: та же неделя год назад (52 строки назад в отсортированном ряду)
      const idx = storeSeries.dates.indexOf(row.date)
      const lastYearIdx = idx - 52
      if (lastYearIdx >= 0) lastYearSum += storeSeries.sales[lastYearIdx]
    }
    return {
      wmae: wSum ? wAbs / wSum : 0,
      forecastSum,
      yoy: lastYearSum ? forecastSum / lastYearSum - 1 : 0,
      lastYearSum,
    }
  }, [walmart, walmartActiveStoreId, walmartHorizonRows])

  // Сезонность по месяцам за всю историю магазина
  const walmartSeasonality = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart || walmartActiveStoreId == null) return []
    const storeSeries = walmart.series_by_store[String(walmartActiveStoreId)]
    if (!storeSeries) return []
    const names = ['Янв', 'Фев', 'Мар', 'Апр', 'Май', 'Июн', 'Июл', 'Авг', 'Сен', 'Окт', 'Ноя', 'Дек']
    const buckets: number[][] = names.map(() => [])
    storeSeries.dates.forEach((date, i) => {
      const m = Number(date.slice(5, 7)) - 1
      if (m >= 0 && m < 12) buckets[m].push(storeSeries.sales[i])
    })
    return names.map((name, i) => ({
      month: name,
      sales: buckets[i].length ? buckets[i].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / buckets[i].length : 0,
    }))
  }, [walmart, walmartActiveStoreId])

  // Таблица по неделям горизонта
  const walmartForecastRows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart || walmartActiveStoreId == null) return []
    const storeSeries = walmart.series_by_store[String(walmartActiveStoreId)]
    if (!storeSeries) return []
    return walmartHorizonRows.map((row) => {
      const idx = storeSeries.dates.indexOf(row.date)
      const lastYearIdx = idx - 52
      const lastYear = lastYearIdx >= 0 ? storeSeries.sales[lastYearIdx] : 0
      const p = row.predicted ?? 0
      return {
        date: row.date,
        forecast: p,
        yoy: lastYear ? p / lastYear - 1 : 0,
        holiday: row.holiday,
      }
    })
  }, [walmart, walmartActiveStoreId, walmartHorizonRows])

  const housingModels = housing?.models ?? []
  const currentRegModel =
    housingModels.find((model) => model.name === selectedRegModel) ??
    housingModels[0] ??
    null
  const currentDiamondModel = diamondsDemo.models.find((model) => model.name === selectedDiamondModel) ?? diamondsDemo.models[diamondsDemo.models.length - 1]

  const walmartBest: WalmartModel | null =
    walmart?.models.reduce<WalmartModel | null>(
      (best, m) => (!best || m.metrics.mape < best.metrics.mape ? m : best),
      null,
    ) ?? null

  const modelComparison = useMemo(() => housingModels.map((model) => ({
    name: model.name,
    rmse: Number(model.metrics.rmse.toFixed(2)),
    r2: Number(model.metrics.r2.toFixed(3)),
    mae: Number(model.metrics.mae.toFixed(2)),
    mape: Number(model.metrics.mape.toFixed(2)),
    maxError: Number(model.metrics.max_error.toFixed(2)),
  })), [housingModels])

  const yActual = housing?.data.y_test ?? []
  const yPredicted = currentRegModel?.predictions ?? []

  const scatterData = useMemo(
    () => yActual.map((actual, i) => ({ actual, predicted: yPredicted[i] ?? 0 })),
    [yActual, yPredicted]
  )
  const residualData = useMemo(
    () => yActual.map((actual, i) => ({
      predicted: yPredicted[i] ?? 0,
      residual: +((yPredicted[i] ?? 0) - actual).toFixed(3),
    })),
    [yActual, yPredicted]
  )
  const residualDistribution = useMemo(() => {
    const residuals = residualData.map((item) => item.residual)
    if (!residuals.length) return [] as { range: string; count: number; center: number }[]
    const min = Math.min(...residuals)
    const max = Math.max(...residuals)
    const binCount = 16
    const width = (max - min) / binCount || 1
    const bins = Array.from({ length: binCount }, (_, index) => ({ range: `${Math.round(min + width * index)}`, count: 0, center: min + width * (index + 0.5) }))
    residuals.forEach((value) => {
      const index = Math.min(binCount - 1, Math.max(0, Math.floor((value - min) / width)))
      bins[index].count += 1
    })
    return bins
  }, [residualData])

  const propertyEstimate = useMemo(() => {
    if (!housing || !currentRegModel) return null
    if (Object.keys(propertyInputs).length === 0) return null

    const raw = predictHousing(propertyInputs, housing.calculator)   // в $100k
    const uncertainty = Math.max(0.05, currentRegModel.metrics.rmse)

    const drivers = housing.meta.features
      .map(f => {
        const median = housing.data.feature_stats[f].median
        return {
          label: HOUSING_LABELS[f] ?? f,
          value: housing.calculator.coefficients[f] * (propertyInputs[f] - median),
        }
      })
      .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.value) - Math.abs(a.value))

    return {
      estimated: raw,
      low:  Math.max(0, raw - uncertainty),
      high: raw + uncertainty,
      drivers,
    }
  }, [housing, propertyInputs, currentRegModel])

  const diamondModelComparison = useMemo(() => diamondsDemo.models.map((model) => ({
    name: model.name,
    rmse: Number(model.metrics.rmse.toFixed(0)),
    r2: Number(model.metrics.r2.toFixed(3)),
    mae: Number(model.metrics.mae.toFixed(0)),
    mape: Number(model.metrics.mape.toFixed(2)),
    maxError: Number(model.metrics.maxError.toFixed(0)),
  })), [])
  const diamondScatterData = useMemo(() => diamondsDemo.y.map((actual, index) => ({ actual, predicted: currentDiamondModel.pred[index] })), [currentDiamondModel])
  const diamondBest = diamondsDemo.models.reduce((best, model) => model.metrics.rmse < best.metrics.rmse ? model : best, diamondsDemo.models[0])
  const diamondEstimate = useMemo(() => {
    const raw = calculateDiamondPrice(diamond)
    const estimated = Math.max(100, raw + currentDiamondModel.metrics.bias)
    const uncertainty = Math.max(estimated * 0.055, currentDiamondModel.metrics.rmse * 0.55)
    const dimensionsAtCarat = {
      ...diamond,
      x: Number((6.5 * Math.cbrt(diamond.carat)).toFixed(2)),
      y: Number((6.5 * Math.cbrt(diamond.carat)).toFixed(2)),
      z: Number((3.9 * Math.cbrt(diamond.carat)).toFixed(2)),
    }
    const atOneCarat: DiamondInputs = { ...diamond, carat: 1, x: 6.5, y: 6.5, z: 3.9 }
    const drivers = [
      { label: 'Каратность', value: raw - calculateDiamondPrice(atOneCarat) },
      { label: 'Чистота', value: raw - calculateDiamondPrice({ ...diamond, clarity: 'VS2' }) },
      { label: 'Цвет', value: raw - calculateDiamondPrice({ ...diamond, color: 'G' }) },
      { label: 'Огранка', value: raw - calculateDiamondPrice({ ...diamond, cut: 'Very Good' }) },
      { label: 'Пропорции размеров', value: raw - calculateDiamondPrice(dimensionsAtCarat) },
      { label: 'Глубина', value: raw - calculateDiamondPrice({ ...diamond, depth: 61.5 }) },
      { label: 'Table', value: raw - calculateDiamondPrice({ ...diamond, table: 57 }) },
    ].sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.value) - Math.abs(a.value))
    return { raw, estimated, low: Math.max(100, estimated - uncertainty), high: estimated + uncertainty, drivers }
  }, [diamond, currentDiamondModel])
  const walmartScatterData = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart || !currentWalmartModel) return []
    const all = walmart.data.y_test.map((actual, i) => ({
      actual,
      predicted: currentWalmartModel.predictions[i] ?? 0,
      store: walmart.data.stores_test[i],
    }))
    return selectedWalmartStore == null
      ? all
      : all.filter((d) => d.store === selectedWalmartStore)
  }, [walmart, currentWalmartModel, selectedWalmartStore])

  const walmartModelsComparison = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart) return []
    return walmart.models.map((m) => ({
      name: m.name,
      r2: Number(m.metrics.r2.toFixed(4)),
      mae: Math.round(m.metrics.mae),
      rmse: Math.round(m.metrics.rmse),
      mape: Number(m.metrics.mape.toFixed(2)),
      medae: Math.round(m.metrics.medae),
      max_error: Math.round(m.metrics.max_error),
      cv_mape: m.cv?.mape_mean != null ? Number(m.cv.mape_mean.toFixed(2)) : null,
    }))
  }, [walmart])

  const walmartPerStore = useMemo(() => {
    if (!walmart) return []
    return [...walmart.per_store].sort((a, b) => a.mape - b.mape)
  }, [walmart])
  const regressionBest = housingModels.length
    ? housingModels.reduce((best, model) => model.metrics.rmse < best.metrics.rmse ? model : best, housingModels[0])
    : null

  const downloadReport = () => {
    const payload = activeModule === 'property'
      ? { source: 'artifact:regression/housing/report.json', section: 'regression-property', selectedModel: currentRegModel?.name, metrics: currentRegModel?.metrics, propertyInputs: propertyInputs, estimate: propertyEstimate }
      : activeModule === 'diamonds'
        ? { source: 'synthetic demo data', section: 'regression-diamonds', selectedModel: currentDiamondModel.name, metrics: currentDiamondModel.metrics, diamondInputs: diamond, estimate: diamondEstimate, sampleSize: diamondsDemo.samples.length }
        : { source: 'artifact:regression/walmart/report.json', section: 'regression-walmart', model: currentWalmartModel?.name, metrics: currentWalmartModel?.metrics, perStore: walmart?.per_store, samplePredictions: walmart?.sample_predictions }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }))
    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href = url
    link.download = activeModule === 'property'
      ? 'regression-report.json'
      : activeModule === 'diamonds'
        ? 'diamonds-regression-report.json'
        : 'walmart-regression-report.json'
    link.click()
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url)
  }

  const updateProperty = (key: string, value: number) =>
    setPropertyInputs(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: value }))
  const updateDiamond = (key: keyof DiamondInputs, value: number | string) => setDiamond((current) => {
    if (key === 'carat') {
      const nextCarat = Number(value)
      const scale = Math.cbrt(nextCarat / Math.max(0.1, current.carat))
      return { ...current, carat: nextCarat, x: Number((current.x * scale).toFixed(2)), y: Number((current.y * scale).toFixed(2)), z: Number((current.z * scale).toFixed(2)) }
    }
    return { ...current, [key]: value } as DiamondInputs
  })
    const walmartFailed = !!walmartError || (!walmartLoading && !walmart)

    if (activeModule === 'walmart' && walmartLoading) {
      return (
        <div className="mlr-root app-shell" data-theme={theme}>
          <div className="page-content" style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            Загрузка отчёта walmart…
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }
    if (activeModule === 'walmart' && walmartFailed) {
      return (
        <div className="mlr-root app-shell" data-theme={theme}>
          <div className="page-content" style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', color: '#fb7185' }}>
            Не удалось загрузить walmart/report.json: {walmartError ?? 'нет данных'}
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }
    const housingFailed = !!housingError || (!housingLoading && !housing)

    if (activeModule === 'property' && housingLoading) {
      return (
        <div className="mlr-root app-shell" data-theme={theme}>
          <div className="page-content" style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center' }}>
            Загрузка отчёта housing…
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }
    if (activeModule === 'property' && housingFailed) {
      return (
        <div className="mlr-root app-shell" data-theme={theme}>
          <div className="page-content" style={{ padding: 40, textAlign: 'center', color: '#fb7185' }}>
            Не удалось загрузить report.json: {housingError ?? 'нет данных'}
          </div>
        </div>
      )
    }

  return (
    <div className="mlr-root app-shell" data-theme={theme}>
      <aside className="sidebar">
        <div className="brand"><div className="brand-mark"><Activity size={19} strokeWidth={2.3} /></div><div className="brand-text">ML Hub<span>Model Performance</span></div></div>
        <div className="nav-caption">РАБОЧЕЕ ПРОСТРАНСТВО</div>
        <button className="nav-item selected" type="button"><BarChart3 size={18} /><span>Регрессия</span><span className="nav-pip" /></button>
        <div className="sidebar-bottom">
          <div className="source-card"><span className="source-dot" /><div><b>Real artifacts + demo</b><span>Housing &amp; Walmart — artifacts · Diamonds — demo</span></div></div>
          <div className="sidebar-note">Недвижимость и Walmart читаются из artifacts/regression/. Алмазы — синтетика.</div>
        </div>
      </aside>

      <main className="main-area">
        <header className="topbar">
          <div className="breadcrumbs"><span>ML Hub</span><span className="crumb-slash">/</span><b>Регрессия</b></div>
          <div className="top-actions">
            <span className="data-badge"><span className="status-dot" /> {(activeModule === 'property' || activeModule === 'walmart') ? 'ARTIFACT' : 'DEMO DATA'}</span>
            <button type="button" className="icon-button" onClick={() => setTheme((current) => current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')} aria-label="Переключить тему" title="Переключить тему">{theme === 'dark' ? <Sun size={17} /> : <Moon size={17} />}</button>
            <button type="button" className="button button-quiet" onClick={downloadReport}><Download size={15} /> Экспорт JSON</button>
          </div>
        </header>

        <div className="page-content">
          <section className="page-title-row">
            <div>
              <div className="eyebrow">MODEL PERFORMANCE CONSOLE</div>
              <h1>Регрессия</h1>
              <p>Метрики моделей, оценка недвижимости и алмазов, регрессия продаж Walmart — в одном пространстве.</p>
            </div>
            <div className="last-run">
              <span className="last-run-icon"><Check size={14} /></span>
              <span>
                <b>Рабочая среда готова</b>
                <small>Housing &amp; Walmart — artifact · Diamonds — demo</small>
              </span>
            </div>
          </section>

          <section className="module-tabs" aria-label="Раздел регрессии">
            <button type="button" className={activeModule === 'property' ? 'module-tab active' : 'module-tab'} onClick={() => setActiveModule('property')}><Building2 size={17} /><span>Недвижимость</span><small>Модель + калькулятор</small></button>
            <button type="button" className={activeModule === 'diamonds' ? 'module-tab active' : 'module-tab'} onClick={() => setActiveModule('diamonds')}><Gem size={17} /><span>Алмазы</span><small>Diamonds · цена и метрики</small></button>
            <button type="button" className={activeModule === 'walmart' ? 'module-tab active' : 'module-tab'} onClick={() => setActiveModule('walmart')}><ShoppingCart size={17} /><span>Walmart Sales</span><small>Регрессия · MAPE как hero</small></button>
          </section>

          {activeModule === 'diamonds' ? (
            <div className="content-stack">
              <section className="control-strip">
                <div className="controls-intro"><span className="control-icon"><SlidersHorizontal size={16} /></span><div><b>Модель оценки бриллиантов</b><span>Одна и та же выборка для сравнения 6 алгоритмов</span></div></div>

function RegressionScatterTooltip({ active, payload }: { active?: boolean; payload?: Array<{ payload: { actual: number; predicted: number } }> }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null
  const point = payload[0].payload
  return <div className="custom-tooltip"><b>Объект</b><span>Факт: {formatMoneyK(point.actual)}</span><span>Прогноз: {formatMoneyK(point.predicted)}</span><span>Ошибка: {formatMoneyK(point.predicted - point.actual)}</span></div>
}

function ResidualTooltip({ active, payload }: { active?: boolean; payload?: Array<{ payload: { predicted: number; residual: number } }> }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null
  const point = payload[0].payload
  return <div className="custom-tooltip"><b>Остаток модели</b><span>Прогноз: {formatMoneyK(point.predicted)}</span><span>Остаток: {formatMoneyK(point.residual)}</span></div>
}

function SalesTooltip({ active, payload }: { active?: boolean; payload?: Array<{ payload: { date: string; actual: number | null; forecast: number | null; low: number | null; high: number | null; holiday?: { icon: string; label: string } } }> }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null
  const point = payload[0].payload
  return <div className="custom-tooltip"><b>{point.date}</b>{point.holiday && <span>{point.holiday.icon} {point.holiday.label}</span>}{point.actual != null && <span>Факт: {formatSales(point.actual)}</span>}{point.forecast != null && <span>Прогноз: {formatSales(point.forecast)}</span>}{point.low != null && point.high != null && <span>95%: {formatSales(point.low)} – {formatSales(point.high)}</span>}</div>
}

function DiamondScatterTooltip({ active, payload }: { active?: boolean; payload?: Array<{ payload: { actual: number; predicted: number } }> }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null
  const point = payload[0].payload
  return <div className="custom-tooltip"><b>Цена бриллианта</b><span>Факт: {formatUsd(point.actual)}</span><span>Прогноз: {formatUsd(point.predicted)}</span><span>Ошибка: {formatUsd(point.predicted - point.actual)}</span></div>
}

function GenericTooltip({ active, payload, label, valueFormatter = (value: number) => formatNumber(value, 2) }: { active?: boolean; payload?: Array<{ value: number; name: string; color?: string }>; label?: string; valueFormatter?: (value: number) => string }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null
  return <div className="custom-tooltip"><b>{label}</b>{payload.map((entry, index) => <span key={`${entry.name}-${index}`}><i className="tooltip-dot" style={{ background: entry.color ?? chartPalette.cyan }} />{entry.name}: {valueFormatter(entry.value)}</span>)}</div>
}

export default RegressionConsole

  confusion_matrix: "Confusion matrix",
  confusion_matrices: "Confusion matrices (все модели)",
  confusion_optimal: "Confusion matrix при оптимальном пороге",
  confusion_normalized: "Confusion matrix (нормированная)",
  roc_ovr: "ROC OvR",
  roc_pr: "ROC vs PR",

  class_balance: "Баланс классов",
  metrics_comparison: "Сравнение моделей",
  mae_by_station: "MAE по станциям",
  eda_overview: "EDA overview",
  eda_stations: "EDA по станциям",
  skill_by_station: "Skill по станциям",
};

export function ChartGrid({ charts, baseUrl }: { charts: Record<string, string>; baseUrl: string }) {
  if (!charts || !Object.keys(charts).length) return null;
  const entries = Object.entries(charts).filter(([, f]) => typeof f === "string" && f.endsWith(".png"));
  return (
    <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
      {entries.map(([key, file]) => (
        <Card key={key}>
          <CardTitle>{TITLES[key] ?? key}</CardTitle>
          <img
            src={`${baseUrl}${file}`}
            alt={key}
            className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl"
            loading="lazy"
          />
        </Card>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

### SIZE: 2228 B   MODIFIED: 2026-10-08 13:10:17

"use client";
import { Card, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useState } from "react";

export function ConfusionMatrix({ labels, matrix }: { labels: string[]; matrix: number[][] }) {
  const [hovered, setHovered] = useState<[number, number] | null>(null);
  if (!matrix.length) return null;
  const max = Math.max(1, ...matrix.flat());
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardTitle>Confusion Matrix</CardTitle>
      <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-thin">
        <div className="inline-grid gap-1" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `110px repeat(${labels.length}, minmax(46px, 1fr))` }}>
          <div />
          {labels.map((l) => <div key={l} className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 text-center truncate px-1">{l}</div>)}
          {matrix.map((row, i) => (
            <div key={`row-${i}`} className="contents">
              <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 flex items-center truncate pr-2">{labels[i]}</div>
              {row.map((val, j) => {
                const intensity = val / max;
                const isDiag = i === j;
                return (
                  <motion.div key={`${i}-${j}`} whileHover={{ scale: 1.08 }}
                    onMouseEnter={() => setHovered([i, j])} onMouseLeave={() => setHovered(null)}
                    className={cn("aspect-square rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-semibold",
                      isDiag ? "text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300" : "text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300")}
                    style={{ backgroundColor: isDiag
                      ? `rgba(16,185,129,${0.1 + intensity * 0.7})`
                      : val > 0 ? `rgba(244,63,94,${0.08 + intensity * 0.6})` : "rgba(148,163,184,0.06)" }}>
                    {val}
                  </motion.div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      {hovered && (
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-3">
          Истинный: <b>{labels[hovered[0]]}</b> → Предсказан: <b>{labels[hovered[1]]}</b>
        </p>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}

"use client";
import { Card, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { ThresholdPoint } from "@/lib/types";

export function CostCalculator({ sweep }: { sweep: ThresholdPoint[] }) {
  const [costFP, setCostFP] = useState(100);
  const [costFN, setCostFN] = useState(500);
  const optimal = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sweep.length) return null;
    return sweep.reduce((best, p) => {
      const c = p.fp * costFP + p.fn * costFN;
      const bc = best.fp * costFP + best.fn * costFN;
      return c < bc ? p : best;
    }, sweep[0]);
  }, [sweep, costFP, costFN]);

  if (!optimal) return null;
  return (
    <Card>
      <CardTitle>Калькулятор стоимости ошибок</CardTitle>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 mt-4">
        <label className="text-sm">
          <span className="text-slate-500 text-xs">Цена FP</span>
          <input type="number" value={costFP} onChange={(e) => setCostFP(+e.target.value)}
            className="w-full mt-1 bg-slate-500/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 outline-none" />
        </label>
        <label className="text-sm">
          <span className="text-slate-500 text-xs">Цена FN</span>
          <input type="number" value={costFN} onChange={(e) => setCostFN(+e.target.value)}
            className="w-full mt-1 bg-slate-500/10 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 outline-none" />
        </label>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-5 p-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-primary-500/10 to-violet-500/10 border border-primary-500/20">
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">Оптимальный порог</p>
        <p className="text-3xl font-black text-primary-500">{optimal.threshold.toFixed(2)}</p>
        <p className="text-sm mt-2">Стоимость: <b>{(optimal.fp * costFP + optimal.fn * costFN).toLocaleString()} ₽</b></p>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">FP: {optimal.fp} · FN: {optimal.fn}</p>
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function FeatureImportance({ data }: { data: { feature: string; importance: number }[] }) {
  if (!data?.length) return null;
  const chartData = [...data].sort((a, b) => b.importance - a.importance);

      <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height={Math.max(220, chartData.length * 44)}>
        <BarChart data={chartData} layout="vertical" margin={{ left: 10, right: 20 }}>
          <XAxis type="number" hide />
          <YAxis dataKey="feature" type="category" width={140} tick={{ fontSize: 11 }} />
          <Tooltip contentStyle={{ fontSize: 12, borderRadius: 12 }} formatter={(v: number) => Number(v).toFixed(4)} />
          <Bar dataKey="importance" radius={[0, 8, 8, 0]}>
            {chartData.map((_, i) => <Cell key={i} fill={colors[i % colors.length]} />)}
          </Bar>
        </BarChart>
      </ResponsiveContainer>
    </Card>
  );
}

const LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  accuracy: "Accuracy",
  balancedAccuracy: "Balanced Acc.",
  precisionMacro: "Precision (macro)",
  recallMacro: "Recall (macro)",
  f1Macro: "F1 (macro)",
  f1Weighted: "F1 (weighted)",
  f05Macro: "F0.5 (macro)",
  f2Macro: "F2 (macro)",
  mcc: "MCC",
  kappa: "Cohen κ",
  rocAuc: "ROC AUC",
  prAuc: "PR AUC",
  top2Accuracy: "Top-2 Acc.",
  top3Accuracy: "Top-3 Acc.",
};

export function MetricsGrid({ metrics }: { metrics: Record<string, number | undefined> }) {
  const order = ["accuracy","balancedAccuracy","precisionMacro","recallMacro","f1Macro","f1Weighted","f05Macro","f2Macro","mcc","kappa","rocAuc","prAuc","top2Accuracy","top3Accuracy"];
  const entries = order
    .map((k) => [k, metrics[k]] as [string, number | undefined])
    .filter(([, v]) => v != null);
  if (!entries.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3">
      {entries.map(([k, v], i) => (
        <motion.div key={k} initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} transition={{ delay: i * 0.02 }}>
          <Card className="p-3.5">
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wide">{LABELS[k] ?? k}</p>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold mt-1">
              {k === "mcc" || k === "kappa" ? num(v as number) : pct(v as number)}
            </p>
          </Card>
        </motion.div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { Card, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/Skeleton";
import { HeroMetric } from "./HeroMetric";
import { MetricsGrid } from "./MetricsGrid";
import { ModelSelector } from "./ModelSelector";
import { ConfusionMatrix } from "./ConfusionMatrix";
import { ThresholdSlider } from "./ThresholdSlider";
import { CostCalculator } from "./CostCalculator";
import { Narrative } from "./Narrative";
import { MetaStats } from "./MetaStats";
import { PerClassTable } from "./PerClassTable";
import { ChartGrid } from "./ChartGrid";
import { SamplePredictions } from "./SamplePredictions";
import { useJson, useCsv } from "@/lib/data/loader";
import { metricsFromModel, modelsFromReport, normalizeSweep } from "@/lib/data/normalize";
import { useAppStore } from "@/lib/store";
import { TaskId } from "@/lib/types";
import { TaskMeta } from "@/lib/data/tasks";

export function TaskPage({ task }: { task: TaskMeta }) {
  const { selectedModel, setSelectedModel, threshold, setThreshold } = useAppStore();
  const { data: report, loading } = useJson<any>(task.reportPath);
  const { rows: sweepRows } = useCsv(task.sweepPath ?? null);

  const models = useMemo(() => modelsFromReport(report), [report]);

  // текущая модель: пользовательский выбор → headline.best_model → первая
  const currentModelId =
    selectedModel[task.id] ??
    report?.headline?.best_model ??
    models[0]?.id;
  const currentModel = useMemo(
    () => report?.models?.find((m: any) => m.name === currentModelId) ?? report?.models?.[0],
    [report, currentModelId]
  );

  const metrics = useMemo(() => metricsFromModel(currentModel), [currentModel]);
  const sweep = useMemo(() => normalizeSweep(sweepRows), [sweepRows]);
  const classNames: string[] = report?.meta?.classes ?? [];
  const matrix: number[][] | null = currentModel?.confusion_matrix ?? null;
  const perClass = currentModel?.per_class ?? {};
  const rareClass: string | undefined = report?.meta?.target_stats?.rare_class;
  const charts: Record<string, string> = report?.charts ?? {};
  const baseUrl = `/artifacts/classification/${task.slug}/`;
  const currentThreshold = threshold[task.id] ?? 0.5;

  const heroValue =
    metrics.f1Macro ?? metrics.f1Weighted ?? metrics.accuracy ?? metrics.rocAuc;
  const heroLabel =
    metrics.f1Macro != null ? "F1 (macro)"
    : metrics.f1Weighted != null ? "F1 (weighted)"
    : metrics.accuracy != null ? "Accuracy"
    : "—";

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <Skeleton className="h-32" />
        <Skeleton className="h-24" />
        <Skeleton className="h-96" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  if (!report) {
    return (
      <Card>
        <CardTitle>Не удалось загрузить report.json</CardTitle>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-2">{task.reportPath}</p>
      </Card>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <HeroMetric
        title={report.meta?.title ?? task.title}
        model={currentModel?.name ?? "—"}
        metricLabel={heroLabel}
        metricValue={heroValue != null ? Number(heroValue).toFixed(4) : "—"}
        tone="info"
        extra={report.headline?.verdict ?? report.meta?.subtitle ?? task.subtitle}
      />

      {models.length > 0 && (
        <ModelSelector
          models={models.map((m) => ({ id: m.id, name: m.name + (m.isBest ? " ★" : "") }))}
          selected={currentModelId}
          onSelect={(id) => setSelectedModel(task.id as TaskId, id)}
        />
      )}

      <MetaStats meta={report.meta} />
      <MetricsGrid metrics={metrics} />
      <Narrative meta={report.meta} headline={report.headline} />

      {sweep.length > 0 && (
        <ThresholdSlider
          sweep={sweep}
          threshold={currentThreshold}
          onChange={(v) => setThreshold(task.id as TaskId, v)}
          costFP={100}
          costFN={task.id === "bc-fn" ? 5000 : 300}
        />
      )}

      <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        {matrix && classNames.length > 0 && (
          <ConfusionMatrix labels={classNames} matrix={matrix} />
        )}
        {Object.keys(perClass).length > 0 && (
          <PerClassTable perClass={perClass} rareClass={rareClass} />
        )}
      </div>

      {sweep.length > 0 && <CostCalculator sweep={sweep} />}

      <ChartGrid charts={charts} baseUrl={baseUrl} />

      <SamplePredictions samples={report.sample_predictions} />

      <Card>
        <CardTitle>Raw report.json</CardTitle>
        <pre className="text-xs overflow-auto scrollbar-thin max-h-72 bg-slate-500/5 p-3 rounded-lg mt-3">
          {JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}
        </pre>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";
import { Card, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/Card";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { ThresholdPoint } from "@/lib/types";

export function ThresholdSlider({ sweep, threshold, onChange, costFP, costFN }:{
  sweep: ThresholdPoint[]; threshold: number; onChange: (v: number) => void;
  costFP?: number; costFN?: number;
}) {
  const current = useMemo(() => {
    if (!sweep.length) return null;
    return sweep.reduce((best, p) => Math.abs(p.threshold - threshold) < Math.abs(best.threshold - threshold) ? p : best, sweep[0]);
  }, [sweep, threshold]);

  if (!current) return null;
  const cost = costFP !== undefined && costFN !== undefined ? current.fp * costFP + current.fn * costFN : null;

  return (
    <Card>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <CardTitle>Порог решения</CardTitle>
        <span className="text-lg font-bold text-primary-500">{threshold.toFixed(2)}</span>
      </div>
      <input type="range" min={0} max={1} step={0.01} value={threshold}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
        className="w-full mt-4 accent-indigo-500 h-2 rounded-full cursor-pointer" />
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-3 mt-5">
        {([["Precision", current.precision],["Recall", current.recall],["F1", current.f1],
           ["F0.5", current.f05],["F2", current.f2],["MCC", current.mcc]] as const).map(([label, val]) => (
          <div key={label} className="text-center">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 uppercase">{label}</p>
            <p className="font-bold text-sm">{Number(val).toFixed(3)}</p>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div className="flex gap-4 mt-4 text-sm">
        <span className="text-rose-500 font-semibold">FP: {current.fp}</span>
        <span className="text-amber-500 font-semibold">FN: {current.fn}</span>
        {cost !== null && <span className="ml-auto font-bold">Стоимость: {cost.toLocaleString()} ₽</span>}
      </div>
    </Card>
  );
}

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
type Tone = "default" | "success" | "danger" | "warning" | "info";
export function Badge({ children, tone = "default", className }: { children: React.ReactNode; tone?: Tone; className?: string }) {
  const tones: Record<Tone, string> = {
    default: "bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-500",
    success: "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-500",
    danger: "bg-rose-500/15 text-rose-500",
    warning: "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-500",
    info: "bg-sky-500/15 text-sky-500",
  };
  return <span className={cn("px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold inline-block", tones[tone], className)}>{children}</span>;
}

export function Tabs({ tabs, value, onValueChange }: { tabs: { id: string; label: string }[]; value: string; onValueChange: (id: string) => void }) {

    <div className="inline-flex gap-1 p-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-500/10">
      {tabs.map((t) => (
        <button key={t.id} onClick={() => onValueChange(t.id)}
          className={cn("px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all",

      ))}
    </div>
  );

type Props = {
  cityIndex: number
  setCityIndex: (value: number) => void
  variableKey: CityVariableKey
  setVariableKey: (value: CityVariableKey) => void
  modelName: string
  setModelName: (value: string) => void
  showInterval: boolean
  setShowInterval: (value: boolean) => void

const fmt = (value: number, digits = 2) => Number.isFinite(value)
  ? value.toLocaleString('ru-RU', { maximumFractionDigits: digits, minimumFractionDigits: 0 }) : '—'
const signed = (value: number, digits = 2) => `${value > 0 ? '+' : ''}${fmt(value, digits)}`

function Panel({ title, subtitle, children, right, className = '' }: { title: string; subtitle?: string; children: ReactNode; right?: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return <section className={`panel ${className}`}>
    <div className="panel-heading"><div><h2>{title}</h2>{subtitle && <p>{subtitle}</p>}</div>{right && <div className="panel-heading-right">{right}</div>}</div>
    {children}
  </section>
}

function Tip({ active, payload, label }: { active?: boolean; payload?: Array<{ value?: number; name?: string; color?: string }>; label?: string }) {
  if (!active || !payload?.length) return null
  return <div className="custom-tooltip"><b>{label}</b>{payload.filter((item) => typeof item.value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(item.value)).map((item, i) =>
    <span key={`${item.name}-${i}`}><i className="tooltip-dot" style={{ background: item.color ?? 'var(--c2)' }} />{item.name}: {fmt(Number(item.value), 2)}</span>)}</div>
}

export default function CityWeatherDashboard({ cityIndex, setCityIndex, variableKey, setVariableKey, modelName, setModelName, showInterval, setShowInterval }: Props) {
  const city = cityWeatherDemo.cities[cityIndex] ?? cityWeatherDemo.cities[0]
  const spec = cityVariables.find((item) => item.key === variableKey) ?? cityVariables[0]
  const variable = city.vars[spec.key]
  const model = variable.models.find((item) => item.name === modelName) ?? variable.models[0]
  const metrics = evaluateCityModel(cityIndex, spec.key, model.name)
  const baseline = evaluateCityModel(cityIndex, spec.key, 'Persistence')
  const points = cityEvaluationPoints(cityIndex, spec.key, model.name)

  const series = useMemo(() => city.dates.map((date, index) => {
    const pred = model.forecast[index]
    const sd = model.sd[index] ?? 0
    return {
      date, tick: cityDateTick(date),
      actual: index < cityWeatherDemo.nPast ? variable.actual[index] : null,
      predicted: pred,
      low: pred == null ? null : pred - 1.64 * sd,
      band: pred == null ? null : 3.28 * sd,
      high: pred == null ? null : pred + 1.64 * sd,
      today: index === cityWeatherDemo.nPast - 1,
    }
  }), [city, model, variable])

  const leadData = useMemo(() => [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7].map((horizon) => {
    const row: Record<string, number | string> = { horizon: `+${horizon} д`, n: horizon }
    const baselineLead = variable.leadMae.Persistence[horizon - 1]
    row[model.name] = variable.leadMae[model.name][horizon - 1]
    row.Persistence = baselineLead
    row.SARIMAX = variable.leadMae.SARIMAX[horizon - 1]
    row.XGBoost = variable.leadMae.XGBoost[horizon - 1]
    row.LSTM = variable.leadMae.LSTM[horizon - 1]
    return row
  }), [variable, model.name])

  const skillData = useMemo(() => cityVariables.map((item) => {
    const result = evaluateCityModel(cityIndex, item.key, model.name)
    return { label: `${item.icon} ${item.label}`, skill: Number((result.skill * 100).toFixed(2)), mae: result.mae, unit: item.unit }
  }), [cityIndex, model.name])

  const comparison = useMemo(() => cityModelNames.map((name) => ({ name, ...evaluateCityModel(cityIndex, spec.key, name) })), [cityIndex, spec.key])
  const testScatter = points.map((point) => ({ actual: point.actual, predicted: point.predicted, date: point.date }))

  const futureDays = Array.from({ length: cityWeatherDemo.forecastDays }, (_, offset) => {
    const index = cityWeatherDemo.nPast + offset
    const get = (key: CityVariableKey) => {
      const data = city.vars[key]
      return data.models.find((candidate) => candidate.name === model.name)?.forecast[index] ?? data.actual[index - 1] ?? 0
    }
    return { date: city.dates[index], temp: get('temp'), hum: get('hum'), rain: get('rain'), wind: get('wind') }
  })

  const winner = [...comparison].sort((a, b) => b.skill - a.skill)[0]
  const Icon = spec.key === 'temp' ? Thermometer : spec.key === 'hum' ? Droplets : spec.key === 'rain' ? CloudRain : spec.key === 'wind' ? Wind : Gauge

  return <div className="content-stack weather-dashboard city-weather-dashboard">
    <section className="control-strip weather-control-strip">

      <label className="select-field weather-select"><span>Город</span><select value={cityIndex} onChange={(event) => setCityIndex(Number(event.target.value))}>{cityWeatherDemo.cities.map((item, index) => <option value={index} key={item.name}>{item.name}</option>)}</select></label>
      <label className="select-field weather-select"><span>Модель</span><select value={model.name} onChange={(event) => setModelName(event.target.value)}>{cityModelNames.map((name) => <option key={name}>{name}</option>)}</select></label>
      <div className="variable-selector"><span>Переменная</span><div className="segmented">{cityVariables.map((item) => <button key={item.key} type="button" className={item.key === spec.key ? 'active' : ''} onClick={() => setVariableKey(item.key)}>{item.icon} {item.label}</button>)}</div></div>
      <div className="weather-toggles"><button type="button" className={`toggle-chip ${showInterval ? 'active' : ''}`} aria-pressed={showInterval} onClick={() => setShowInterval(!showInterval)}>90% интервал прогноза</button><span className="model-context"><i className="mini-status" /> {model.name} · {spec.unit}</span></div>
    </section>

    <section className="weather-hero panel">
      <div className="weather-hero-heading"><div><h2><Icon size={19} /> {city.name} <span>·</span> {spec.label}</h2><p>Бэктест за 14 последних исторических дней · прогноз на 7 дней вперёд · модель {model.name}</p></div><span className={metrics.skill >= 0 ? 'skill-badge-positive' : 'skill-badge-negative'}>{metrics.skill >= 0 ? '↑' : '↓'} Skill {signed(metrics.skill * 100, 1)}%</span></div>
      <div className="weather-hero-stats">
        <div><span>MAE · {spec.unit}</span><b>{fmt(metrics.mae)}</b></div>

'Лучше persistence по MAE' : 'Хуже persistence по MAE'}</span><span className="weather-info-pill">Лучший алгоритм для выбора: <b>{winner?.name ?? '—'}</b></span></div>

function OverviewPage({ goStations, goCities, goModels, stationId, stationModel, stationHorizon, cityIndex }: {
  goStations: () => void; goCities: () => void; goModels: () => void; stationId: number; stationModel: string; stationHorizon: number; cityIndex: number
}) {

  }).sort((a, b) => b.skill - a.skill), [])
  const forecastCity = cityWeatherDemo.cities[cityIndex] ?? cityWeatherDemo.cities[0]
  const temp = forecastCity.vars.temp
  const forecastModel = temp.models.find((item) => item.name === 'LSTM') ?? temp.models[0]

  })
  const CityIcon = cityIndex === 0 ? CloudSun : cityIndex === 1 ? Wind : cityIndex === 2 ? CloudRain : Sun
  return <div className="content-stack">
    <section className="overview-banner"><div className="overview-banner-copy"><div className="banner-kicker"><span className="source-dot" /> WEATHER ML LAB · DEMO</div><h2>Погода — от прогноза до качества модели</h2><p>Интерактивная консоль для бэктеста температурных рядов и оценки нескольких погодных параметров. Все наблюдения синтетические, вычисляются в браузере и не требуют API.</p><div className="banner-actions"><button type="button" className="button button-primary" onClick={goStations}>Открыть бэктест станций <ArrowDownRight size={14} /></button><button type="button" className="button" onClick={goCities}>Городской прогноз <ArrowDownRight size={14} /></button></div></div><div className="overview-weather-mark"><div className="weather-orbit orbit-one" /><div className="weather-orbit orbit-two" /><CloudSun size={76} strokeWidth={1.1} /><span>ML</span></div></section>

    <section className="metrics-grid overview-metrics">

function ModelsPage({ cityIndex, cityVariable }: { cityIndex: number; cityVariable: CityVariableKey }) {
  const stationRanking = useMemo(() => weatherModels.map((model) => {
    const cells = weatherDemo.stationData.flatMap((station) => weatherDemo.horizons.map((h) => station.evaluations[model.name][h]))
    return { name: model.name, mae: mean(cells.map((cell) => cell.metrics.mae)), rmse: mean(cells.map((cell) => cell.metrics.rmse)), r2: mean(cells.map((cell) => cell.metrics.r2)), skill: mean(cells.map((cell) => cell.metrics.skill)), baseline: model.isBaseline }
  }).sort((a, b) => b.skill - a.skill), [])
  const cityRanking = useMemo(() => cityModelNames.map((name) => {
    const cells = cityWeatherDemo.cities.flatMap((_, ci) => cityVariables.map((variable) => evaluateCityModel(ci, variable.key, name)))
    return { name, skill: mean(cells.map((item) => item.skill)), mae: mean(cells.map((item) => item.mae)), rmse: mean(cells.map((item) => item.rmse)), r2: mean(cells.map((item) => item.r2)) }
  }).sort((a, b) => b.skill - a.skill), [])
  const cityRows = cityModelNames.map((name) => ({ name, ...evaluateCityModel(cityIndex, cityVariable, name) }))
  return <div className="content-stack">
    <section className="metrics-grid overview-metrics"><Metric label="Station benchmark" value="84" note="6 моделей × 14 горизонтов на станцию" icon={<BarChart3 size={16} />} /><Metric label="Station evaluations" value="420" note="5 станции × 84 комбинации" tone="green" icon={<Database size={16} />} /><Metric label="City evaluations" value="80" note="4 города × 5 переменных × 4 модели" tone="amber" icon={<CloudSun size={16} />} /><Metric label="Горизонты" value="1–14 дн." note="Подробная оценка на каждом горизонте" tone="purple" icon={<Activity size={16} />} /></section>
    <section className="two-column">
      <Panel title="Station benchmark · средний Skill" subtitle="Температурные станции · среднее по всем станциям и горизонтам"><div className="chart-area chart-medium"><ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%"><BarChart data={stationRanking} margin={{ top: 8, right: 12, bottom: 4, left: -12 }}><CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 5" vertical={false} stroke="var(--chart-grid)" /><XAxis dataKey="name" tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 9 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} interval={0} angle={-16} textAnchor="end" height={55} /><YAxis tickFormatter={(value) => `${Math.round(Number(value) * 100)}%`} tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 9 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} /><Tooltip content={<ChartTip />} /><ReferenceLine y={0} stroke="var(--muted)" /><Bar dataKey="skill" name="Средний Skill" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}>{stationRanking.map((row) => <Cell key={row.name} fill={row.baseline ? 'var(--muted-2)' : row.skill >= 0 ? 'var(--c3)' : 'var(--c5)'} />)}</Bar></BarChart></ResponsiveContainer></div></Panel>
      <Panel title="City benchmark · средний Skill" subtitle="Все 4 города и 5 переменных · значения Skill усреднены по единицам задачи"><div className="chart-area chart-medium"><ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%"><BarChart data={cityRanking} margin={{ top: 8, right: 12, bottom: 4, left: -12 }}><CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 5" vertical={false} stroke="var(--chart-grid)" /><XAxis dataKey="name" tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 9 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} /><YAxis tickFormatter={(value) => `${Math.round(Number(value) * 100)}%`} tick={{ fill: 'var(--muted)', fontSize: 9 }} tickLine={false} axisLine={false} /><Tooltip content={<ChartTip />} /><ReferenceLine y={0} stroke="var(--muted)" /><Bar dataKey="skill" name="Средний Skill" radius={[4, 4, 0, 0]}>{cityRanking.map((row) => <Cell key={row.name} fill={row.skill >= 0 ? export default function WeatherConsole() {
  const [theme, setTheme] = useState<Theme>('dark')
  const [activePage, setActivePage] = useState<Page>('overview')
  const [stationId, setStationId] = useState(20891)
  const [stationModel, setStationModel] = useState('XGBoost')
  const [stationHorizon, setStationHorizon] = useState(7)
  const [showStationBaseline, setShowStationBaseline] = useState(true)
  const [showSkillCorridor, setShowSkillCorridor] = useState(true)
  const [sampleMode, setSampleMode] = useState<WeatherSampleMode>('accurate')
  const [cityIndex, setCityIndex] = useState(0)
  const [cityVariable, setCityVariable] = useState<CityVariableKey>('temp')
  const [cityModel, setCityModel] = useState('LSTM')
  const [showCityInterval, setShowCityInterval] = useState(true)

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme
  }, [theme])

  const selectedStation = weatherDemo.stationData.find((item) => item.station.id === stationId) ?? weatherDemo.stationData[0]
  const selectedEvaluation = selectedStation.evaluations[stationModel][stationHorizon]
  const selectedCity = cityWeatherDemo.cities[cityIndex] ?? cityWeatherDemo.cities[0]
  const selectedCityMetrics = evaluateCityModel(cityIndex, cityVariable, cityModel)

  const exportReport = () => {
    const stationRows = selectedEvaluation.points.map((point) => ({ date: point.date, actual_c: point.actual, forecast_c: point.predicted, error_c: point.error, abs_error_c: point.abs_error, within_mae: point.within_mae, outlier: point.is_outlier }))
    const cityVariableData = selectedCity.vars[cityVariable]
    const selectedCityForecast = cityVariableData.models.find((item) => item.name === cityModel) ?? cityVariableData.models[0]
    const future = Array.from({ length: cityWeatherDemo.forecastDays }, (_, offset) => {
      const index = cityWeatherDemo.nPast + offset
      return { date: selectedCity.dates[index], forecast: selectedCityForecast.forecast[index], interval_low: (selectedCityForecast.forecast[index] ?? 0) - 1.64 * (selectedCityForecast.sd[index] ?? 0), interval_high: (selectedCityForecast.forecast[index] ?? 0) + 1.64 * (selectedCityForecast.sd[index] ?? 0) }
    })
    const report = {
      title: 'Weather ML Console', source: 'synthetic demo data', generated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      station_benchmark: { station: selectedStation.station, model: stationModel, horizon_days: stationHorizon, metrics: selectedEvaluation.metrics, predictions: stationRows },
      city_benchmark: { city: selectedCity.name, variable: cityVariable, model: cityModel, unit: cityVariables.find((item) => item.key === cityVariable)?.unit, metrics: selectedCityMetrics, backtest: cityVariableData.actual.slice(cityWeatherDemo.backStart, cityWeatherDemo.nPast).map((actual, offset) => ({ date: selectedCity.dates[cityWeatherDemo.backStart + offset], actual, predicted: selectedCityForecast.forecast[cityWeatherDemo.backStart + offset] })), future_forecast: future },
      station_skill_by_horizon: Object.fromEntries(weatherDemo.horizons.map((h) => [h, selectedStation.evaluations[stationModel][h].metrics.skill])),
      city_models: cityModelNames,
    }
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }))
    const link = document.createElement('a')
    link.href = url
    link.download = `weather-ml-report-${selectedStation.station.id}-${stationModel}-h${stationHorizon}.json`
    link.click()
    window.setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000)
  }

  const navItems: { id: Page; label: string; icon: typeof CloudSun; meta: string }[] = [
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Обзор', icon: LayoutDashboard, meta: 'сводка и KPI' },
    { id: 'stations', label: 'Станции', icon: Thermometer, meta: '1–14 дней · бэктест' },
    { id: 'cities', label: 'Города и переменные', icon: CloudSun, meta: '5 параметров погоды' },
    { id: 'models', label: 'Модели и метрики', icon: BarChart3, meta: 'лидерборды' },
    { id: 'features', label: 'Признаки и справочник', icon: Layers3, meta: 'features · метрики' },
  ]
  const activeMeta = pageMeta[activePage]
  const ActiveIcon = activeMeta.icon

  return <div className="mlr-root app-shell" data-theme={theme}>
    <aside className="sidebar">
      <div className="brand"><div className="brand-mark"><CloudSun size={21} /></div><div className="brand-text">Weather ML Console<span>Forecasting · Model Quality</span></div></div>
      <div className="nav-caption">ПОГОДНЫЙ КОНТУР</div>
      <nav className="nav-stack" aria-label="Навигация по погоде">{navItems.map((item) => {
        const Icon = item.icon
        return <button type="button" key={item.id} className={`nav-item ${activePage === item.id ? 'selected' : ''}`} onClick={() => setActivePage(item.id)} aria-current={activePage === item.id ? 'page' : undefined}><Icon size={17} /><span className="nav-label">{item.label}<small>{item.meta}</small></span>{activePage === item.id && <span className="nav-pip" />}</button>
      })}</nav>
      <div className="sidebar-bottom"><div className="source-card"><span className="source-dot" /><div><b>DEMO DATASET</b><span>локальная генерация · API не требуется</span></div></div><div className="sidebar-note">Только погодные разделы. Не является системой оперативного метеопрогноза.</div></div>
    </aside>

    <main className="main-area">
      <header className="topbar"><div className="breadcrumbs"><ActiveIcon size={15} /><span>Weather ML</span><span className="crumb-slash">/</span><b>{activeMeta.title}</b></div><div className="top-actions"><span className="data-badge"><i className="status-dot" /> SYNTHETIC DEMO</span><button type="button" className="button button-quiet" onClick={exportReport}><Download size={14} /> Экспорт JSON</button><button type="button" className="icon-button" title={theme === 'dark' ? 'Переключить на светлую тему' : 'Переключить на тёмную тему'} aria-label="Переключить тему" onClick={() => setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark')}>{theme === 'dark' ? <Sun size={15} /> : <Moon size={15} />}</button><button type="button" className="icon-button" title="Печать / сохранить PDF" aria-label="Печать" onClick={() => window.print()}><Printer size={15} /></button></div></header>
      <div className="page-content">
        <div className="page-title-row"><div><div className="eyebrow">WEATHER / {activePage.toUpperCase()}</div><h1>{activeMeta.title}</h1><p>{activeMeta.subtitle}</p></div><div className="last-run"><span className="last-run-icon"><CheckCircle2 size={15} /></span><div><b>Демо готово к анализу</b><small>{weatherDemo.stations.length} станций · {weatherDemo.horizons.length} горизонтов · {cityVariables.length} переменных</small></div></div></div>
        <section className="module-tabs" aria-label="Раздел погоды">
          {navItems.map((item) => {
            const Icon = item.icon
            return (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={item.id}
                className={`module-tab ${activePage === item.id ? 'active' : ''}`}
                onClick={() => setActivePage(item.id)}
                aria-current={activePage === item.id ? 'page' : undefined}
              >
                <Icon size={17} />
                <span>{item.label}</span>
                <small>{item.meta}</small>
              </button>
            )
          })}
        </section>
        {activePage === 'overview' && <OverviewPage goStations={() => setActivePage('stations')} goCities={() => setActivePage('cities')} goModels={() => setActivePage('models')} stationId={stationId} stationModel={stationModel} stationHorizon={stationHorizon} cityIndex={cityIndex} />}
        {activePage === 'stations' && <WeatherDashboard stationId={stationId} setStationId={setStationId} modelName={stationModel} setModelName={setStationModel} horizon={stationHorizon} setHorizon={setStationHorizon} showBaseline={showStationBaseline} setShowBaseline={setShowStationBaseline} showSkillCorridor={showSkillCorridor} setShowSkillCorridor={setShowSkillCorridor} sampleMode={sampleMode} setSampleMode={setSampleMode} />}
        {activePage === 'cities' && <CityWeatherDashboard cityIndex={cityIndex} setCityIndex={setCityIndex} variableKey={cityVariable} setVariableKey={setCityVariable} modelName={cityModel} setModelName={setCityModel} showInterval={showCityInterval} setShowInterval={setShowCityInterval} />}
        {activePage === 'models' && <ModelsPage cityIndex={cityIndex} cityVariable={cityVariable} />}
        {activePage === 'features' && <FeaturesPage />}
        <footer className="page-footer"><span>Weather ML Console <span className="footer-separator">/</span> forecasting &amp; model evaluation</span><span>Демо-данные · синтетика · локальный React-проект</span></footer>
      </div>
    </main>
  </div>
}

import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import {
  ArrowDownRight,
  ArrowUpRight,
  CalendarDays,
  CheckCircle2,
  CloudSun,
  Info,
  MapPin,
  Thermometer,
  XCircle,
} from 'lucide-react'
import {
  Area,
  Bar,
  BarChart,
  CartesianGrid,
  Cell,
  ComposedChart,
  Legend,
  Line,
  LineChart,
  ReferenceLine,
  ResponsiveContainer,
  Tooltip,
  XAxis,
  YAxis,
} from 'recharts'
import {
  featureImportance,
  mean,
  meanSkillForModel,
  weatherDemo,
  weatherModels,
  type WeatherEvaluation,
  type WeatherStationDataset,
